sources.beginner: hand-calc from the prompt's tally and catalog inputs as src/content/courses/completion/beginner/m06-the-associate-reading/l02-working-the-capstone.md directs; the panel src/components/course/panels/completion/StringExplorer.jsx has no custom-string input (SelectField only) but its drift table prints drifts to 7 decimals (StringExplorer.jsx:68).
sources.intermediate: hand-calc as src/content/courses/completion/intermediate/m06-the-professional-reading/l02-working-the-capstone.md directs; src/components/course/panels/completion/ClearanceExplorer.jsx takes only a warn margin for the published string, so the capstone string must be worked by hand (answers are exact inch x 0.0254 differences plus two pi-based volume sums).
sources.advanced: hand-calc from four prompt numbers (src/content/courses/completion/advanced/m06-the-expert-reading/l02-working-the-capstone.md), and src/components/course/panels/completion/SpaceoutExplorer.jsx:39-42 takes PBR, elongation, contraction and margin as inputs and prints the band edges and shortest PBR to 4 decimals (fmt at SpaceoutExplorer.jsx:14).

fields.evidence: Sum of the fourteen lengths from a surface hanger = 2600.65 exactly; the prompt states the identity. tol 5e-7 is fine for an exact two-decimal sum.
Running sum through the packer row = 2594.4 exactly; a terminating decimal the learner types in full.
(6.094 - 0.125) x 0.0254 = 0.1516126 exactly (7 decimals); tol 5e-8 is half a unit of the 7th decimal and the value is exact at 7 decimals.
fields.notes: Possible LEAK: the ClearanceExplorer size matrix prints '7.00 in 32.0 lb/ft 0.1516126' in its default state (probe). It is the catalog drift the lessons teach, so it is a lookup more than a leak, but the capstone's own 'trap' (32 lb/ft not 29) is answered on screen.

fields.evidence: (12.415 - 5/32) x 0.0254 = 0.31137225 exactly, an 8-decimal value sitting exactly on the 7-decimal rounding boundary; stored expected 0.31137224999999996, tol 5e-8. The panel prints drifts to 7 decimals (fmt(r.driftM, 7)) and shows 0.3113722, which passes by 4e-17; a learner who rounds half up to 0.3113723 fails by 4e-17.
fields.notes: Possible LEAK: StringExplorer's drift table prints '13.375 68.00 -0.15625 0.3113722' in default state (probe), which is this field's answer (12.415 in bore is 13-3/8 68 lb/ft). Loosening only; cannot flip a pass.

fields.evidence: Sum of pi/4 x ID^2 x L over 14 rows; 7.852067852872 rounds to 7.852068 at the panel's 6-decimal volume convention (diff 1.5e-7 <= 5e-7).
fields.notes: tol 5e-7 is exactly half a unit of the 6-decimal print convention (panel fmt 6); it demands full-precision pi and no rounding of intermediate areas (pi = 3.14159 alone moves the answer by 7e-6). Honest by the rule, but unforgiving; owner may prefer 5e-4 for a 14-row hand sum.

fields.evidence: Sum of pi/4 x OD^2 x L; 17.767445424 rounds to 17.767445 at 6 decimals (diff 4.2e-7 <= 5e-7, close to the edge).
fields.notes: Same fragility as capacity: 6-decimal rounding passes by 8e-8 only; 5 decimals fails.

fields.evidence: Liner drift 0.1516126 - packer OD 5.875 x 0.0254 (0.149225) = 0.0023876 exactly; tol 5e-8 is half a unit of the 7th decimal of an exact value.
fields.notes: Panel prints clearances in mm to 4 decimals (x1000), i.e. 7 decimals in metres, consistent.

fields.evidence: Governing drift is the liner drift 0.1516126 (liner top 2000 m is above the mandrel) less 5.0 x 0.0254 = 0.0246126 exactly.
XN bore 2.205 x 0.0254 = 0.056007 exactly; panel prints through bore to 6 decimals.
X nipple bore 2.313 x 0.0254 = 0.0587502 exactly (7 decimals); exact value, tol 5e-8.
fields.notes: The panel's 6-decimal through-bore tile would print 0.05875 (diff 2e-7, fails), but that tile shows the published string, not the capstone; the learner works it by hand.

fields.evidence: Exposed-profile annulus sum over three strings with pi; 67.275859268 rounds to 67.275859 at 6 decimals (diff 2.7e-7 <= 5e-7).
fields.notes: tol 5e-7 on a ~67 m3 multi-segment hand sum is a relative tol of 7e-9; honest only for a full-precision spreadsheet. Owner may prefer 5e-4.

fields.evidence: Full casing bore x length below the packer less the tail steel, with pi; 5.715910667 rounds to 5.715911 (diff 3.3e-7 <= 5e-7).
5.35 - 2.28 = 3.07, a two-decimal exact subtraction taught in the capstone lesson.
2.28 - 3.15 = -0.87 exact; sign is stated in the prompt as part of the answer.
SpaceoutExplorer accepts PBR 5.35, elongation 0.65, contraction -3.15, margin 0.4 and prints 'Shallowest landing' = 3.55 (fmt 4 decimals); also 3.15 + 0.4 by hand.
Panel 'Shortest usable PBR' = 4.6; by hand 0.65 + 3.15 + 2 x 0.4 = 4.60.
